name: justinpriday.flutter-tools
description: Worktree-bound Flutter devices, run controls, console, DevTools, screenshots, and Android recordings.
tagline: A focused Flutter cockpit inside every Daintree worktree.

commands.title: Flutter: Open Tools
commands.description: Open Flutter Tools bound to the visible worktree.

commands.title: Flutter: Open Another Tools Panel
commands.description: Open another independent Flutter Tools panel for the visible worktree.

settings.label: Flutter SDK directory
settings.description: Optional Flutter SDK directory. FVM and PATH are discovered automatically when empty.

settings.label: Project search depth
settings.description: Maximum folder depth used to discover nested Flutter applications.

settings.label: Capture save folder
settings.description: Optional folder where new screenshots and screen recordings are saved. When empty, Flutter Tools uses its private storage.
